messages.en:
{07 16 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}Right now, my heart is

{07 0f 00}I'm sorry, but would you
mind leaving me alone for a
while, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
messages.et:
{07 16 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}Praegu vajub mu süda
